title: The matching scheme of a termwise fibre product is the fibre product of the matching schemes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $U_\bullet\to X$, $V_\bullet\to X$ be augmented simplicial $X$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover]. Let $W_\bullet\to X$ be the augmented simplicial $X$-scheme with $W_n=U_n\times_XV_n$ (fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] of the structure morphisms to $X$), whose face and degeneracy maps are the induced morphisms $d_i\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}d_i$, $s_i\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}s_i$ and whose augmentation is the structure morphism $W_0\to X$, and let $p:W_\bullet\to U_\bullet$, $q:W_\bullet\to V_\bullet$ be the termwise projections. For $n\geq0$ write $M_n(-)$ for the matching scheme of [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover]: $M_0(-)=X$, and for $n\geq1$ the limit, in schemes over $X$, of the diagram formed by the terms in degrees $k<n$ indexed by the injective non-identity order-preserving maps $\delta:[k]\to[n]$ (with the simplicial operators between them), and write $\mu_n^U:U_n\to M_n(U)$ for the matching map whose $\delta$-component is the simplicial operator of $\delta$ (for $n=0$ the augmentation). Then for every $n\geq0$ the morphism $(M_n(p),M_n(q)):M_n(W)\to M_n(U)\times_XM_n(V)$ induced by $p$ and $q$ is an isomorphism, and under it $\mu_n^W$ corresponds to the induced morphism $\mu_n^U\times_{\mathrm{id}_X}\mu_n^V:U_n\times_XV_n\to M_n(U)\times_XM_n(V)$.

proof.text: For every n, project the proper-face cone MW along the natural transformations p and q. Naturality makes these cones cU and cV. Lift them through the supplied limiting cones MU and MV to obtain Mp and Mq; IsLimit.fac gives exactly their displayed component identities. This construction uses the supplied matching limits, not any finite-split-hypercover theorem.

Construct an inverse from MU.pt × MV.pt to MW.pt. At every proper face a, the termwise binary-product limit hW lifts the pair prod.fst ≫ MU.π.app a and prod.snd ≫ MV.π.app a to W at that face. After p and q, naturality of this family is precisely cone naturality for MU and MV; binary-product uniqueness proves naturality before projection. The resulting cone lifts through hMW to the inverse map. Products in Over X are scheme fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product].

Check the first inverse identity by hMW.hom_ext, then by termwise binary-product hom_ext, using the component equations for Mp, Mq and the constructed inverse. Check the second inverse identity after prod.fst and prod.snd and then after every component of MU and MV, using their limiting-cone hom_ext. Thus prod.lift Mp Mq is an isomorphism. The same proof covers n=0: the face-component conditions are empty and the limiting cones are terminal.

For matching-map compatibility, compare after the two product projections and then after every proper-face projection of MU and MV. Rewrite the component equations for Mp, Mq, μU, μV and μW. Each remaining equality is naturality of p or q at the proper-face map. Limit hom_ext and binary-product hom_ext give the claimed equality, including degree zero.

lean.statement: theorem matching_object_fibre_product (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V W : SimplicialObject (Over X)) (p : W ⟶ U) (q : W ⟶ V) (_hW : ∀ Δ : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ, IsLimit (BinaryFan.mk (p.app Δ) (q.app Δ))) (n : ℕ) (MU : Cone (properFaceDiagram U n)) (MV : Cone (properFaceDiagram V n)) (MW : Cone (properFaceDiagram W n)) (_hMU : IsLimit MU) (_hMV : IsLimit MV) (_hMW : IsLimit MW) (μU : U.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)) ⟶ MU.pt) (μV : V.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)) ⟶ MV.pt) (μW : W.obj (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)) ⟶ MW.pt) (_hμU : ∀ a : ProperFaceCategory n, μU ≫ MU.π.app (op a) = U.map a.obj.hom.op) (_hμV : ∀ a : ProperFaceCategory n, μV ≫ MV.π.app (op a) = V.map a.obj.hom.op) (_hμW : ∀ a : ProperFaceCategory n, μW ≫ MW.π.app (op a) = W.map a.obj.hom.op) : ∃ (Mp : MW.pt ⟶ MU.pt) (Mq : MW.pt ⟶ MV.pt), (∀ a : ProperFaceCategory n, Mp ≫ MU.π.app (op a) = MW.π.app (op a) ≫ p.app (op a.obj.left)) ∧ (∀ a : ProperFaceCategory n, Mq ≫ MV.π.app (op a) = MW.π.app (op a) ≫ q.app (op a.obj.left)) ∧ IsIso (prod.lift Mp Mq) ∧ μW ≫ prod.lift Mp Mq = prod.lift (p.app (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)) ≫ μU) (q.app (op (SimplexCategory.mk n)) ≫ μV)
